question: In a code language, 'JASMINE' is coded as '213' and 'TULIP' is coded as '234'. How will 'CHAMELI' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 'JASMINE' is coded as '213'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05685b85176eba0c6e66c0926dd8d31f2a7e8961e7d59a39a428c448a34a3720.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b20c06bab9b2090460ab669579bd46659030f3075de846d3584122060cbbcbb1.png] 

'TULIP' is coded as '234'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91938910860a61c56c5583231529cd4138476c5b3a353e9d4a1377a6d9ab2506.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8ed65854848fd737def44004a5343517d715f70f4b93da20639e4db005c7894.png] 

'CHAMELI' be coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f4ce77d3141fe1062d9e34d6dcdc9eeaff0260359ad77131c8f76874609634.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2a7c4c75521ba2ca701492edc20bbfc0f089ba49302c34c3783fb15e8655f2f.png]

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
